about.title: A project to
about.paragraph1: PrivateChat was created as part of my Web/App developer training. Beyond being a training project, it is an opportunity for me to discover new technologies, deepen my skills, and take on technical challenges I have not yet had the chance to explore.
about.paragraph2: My goal is simple: to learn, experiment, and push my limits to turn an idea into a real project while continuing to grow as a developer.
